production_scope: Host-only training terminal launch consolidation after the completed downward pass; retain reverse-level action/chance processing. CUDA, arithmetic, buffers, maps, evaluation scheduling, block dimensions, dynamic shared bytes and kernel ABI remain unchanged. Training terminal grid sizes, launch count and launch order intentionally change. Actual device grid-x limit and checked full-list counts govern bounded fallback.
unit_screen: GPU-only ordinary library 85 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored, 0 measured, 0 filtered. Sealed source adds one host geometry/count/fallback test and extends the existing original per-level lifecycle reference path; inventory remains prospective until execution.
aggregate_gate: At least2 percent reduction in the sum of complete-cycle fixture medians across all3 alternating pairs.
fixture_guard: Reject if a fixture median is more than3 percent slower and a strict majority (minimum2) of paired repetitions are more than3 percent slower.
exactness: All complete non-timing result and configuration fields, full fingerprints, stopping iterations and exploitability bits match. Every raw run remains preserved.
broader_qualification_if_pass: Independent primary audit, original 160 state/menu/resume records, 3 F32, 6 GPU, relevant standalone/continuation/paging/stored paths, fixed wide-turn and fresh-original 3-pair cumulative qualification under separate authorization. No acceptance from the primary alone.
measurement_boundaries: Frozen compressed3-fixture native complete cycles include construction/allocation, GPU initialization including runtime NVRTC/JIT, fixed-quality solving/checks and full readback. Cargo, final fingerprinting/destruction, browser/API latency and disk saving excluded. Warm driver cache disclosed.
script_freeze: Execution scripts and candidate/source identities will be sealed and independently checked before build/native launch; this prospective measurement order and gates must remain unchanged.
candidate_source_authorization: Root pins the sole candidate source, independent source/script reviews, accepted E020/server evidence and the frozen source/protocol/scripts before activation and build. No resource probe or direct-kernel prerequisite; no automatic activation from source feasibility.

wide_turn_holdout_if_pass.guard: Median slowdown greater than3 percent AND at least2 of3 paired slowdowns greater than3 percent rejects adoption. No2 percent gain requirement on holdout. Failure to reach target by400 is inconclusive/failed qualification, not permission to retune.
wide_turn_holdout_if_pass.exactness: All6 complete CPU store files byte-identical; every non-timing field, root vector, stopping iteration and convergence trajectory exact.
wide_turn_holdout_if_pass.admission: Unchanged 2GiB constructor budget, 4GiB device free/30GiB total, 16GiB host available, 50GiB S reserve plus outputs; hands1128/1128, river max1081/1081, 48 river cards, node bound11691. No new device buffers, duplicate planning pass, budget relaxation or rescue.
wide_turn_holdout_if_pass.harness: Reuse exact R2 evaluator/resource/raw-codec provenance and numerical body; separately freeze E020/E032 bindings and per-arm unused Cargo targets before build. No shared-target reuse.
wide_turn_holdout_if_pass.resource: CUDA, block dimensions, dynamic shared bytes and kernel ABI remain E020-identical; training terminal grid sizes, launch count and order intentionally change. No resource probe or arbitrary register/occupancy gate; normal admission and native fixed holdout guard apply.

prerequisites: terminal successful E020 server qualification evidence
separate root activation and execution authorization
cuda_provenance: One fresh GPU-only build produces both library-test and benchmark executables, each containing complete unchanged E020 CUDA. Exactly one changed accepted-map entry; 161 unowned entries including CUDA/evaluator remain exact. Fresh solver/test artifacts, source paths, GPU-only features and target containment establish host-change provenance.
resource_gate: No arbitrary register, spill or occupancy nonregression threshold. Normal correct device admission and fixed complete-cycle/fixture gates govern qualification.
conditional_terminal_checks: Before adoption, compare immutable old E020/candidate full states for compressed and F32 across graph/eager/profiled, warm/resume, locks, post-evaluation, standalone and continuation/paging/stored paths. Check full terminal-list coverage, empty kinds, count/grid bounds and fallback. Do not compare undefined scratch or padding. The test-only original per-level path shares the dispatch helper and therefore has limited independence; frozen E020 executable comparisons remain necessary.
cleanup: Root preserves all candidate bytes, patch, logs and failed judgments, restores only the one owned mod.rs to its accepted E020 bytes, verifies the entire 162-entry accepted map and unchanged live desktop-runtime executable. The scripts terminate only their owned child process trees on failure while retaining the build/GPU lock; no destructive workspace cleanup.
failure_policy: A failed primary stops this candidate: no broader/holdout/cumulative work, no exclusions, extensions or outcome-driven rescue. Any prospective later qualification requires separate authorization.
